solutionContexts.label: Cadmium source stock · full prepared batch
solutionContexts.scope: Main p.1: full stock prepared from 1.2 g CdO, 30 g oleic acid and 120 g ODE; 100 °C degas 30 min, nitrogen 300 °C for 6 h, 100 °C degas 30 min, held at 60 °C. The separate reaction uses a 7.5 g aliquot corresponding to 0.47 mmol Cd. Final stock volume, molarity and coordination species are unreported. Components are source input references, not a measured solution or proof that input CdO remains unchanged.

solutionContexts.label: ODE/Se stock · full prepared batch
solutionContexts.scope: Main p.1: full stock prepared from 0.744 g (9.4 mmol) Se powder and 80 g ODE; 100 °C degas 20 min, nitrogen 200 °C for 2 h, colorless to orange-red to transparent yellow, cooled to room temperature and stable for weeks under nitrogen. Seven ODE/Se route families use a separate 4 g aliquot corresponding to 0.47 mmol Se; the TOPSe comparator does not use this stock. Final stock volume, molarity and dissolved Se species are unreported; the polymeric-Se discussion is an interpretation, not a molecular identity assignment.
